attribution: Authored by the test bench. Jev selects among these typed actions; it does not generate this rationale.
global_requirements: Confirm current evidence and exact target identity.
Preserve relevant evidence with timestamps, source IDs, and hashes before destructive recovery.
Record authorized approval and assess dependencies and service impact.
Verify action completion from the target system, not merely a successful tool invocation.
Verify attack behavior stops; monitor for alternate sessions, credentials, and affected assets.
Recover only after eradication and an approved validation plan. Retain an audit trail.

isolate_endpoint.scope: One verified noncritical EDR device ID, retaining management access.
isolate_endpoint.preserve: Process tree, relevant file hashes, network connections, and volatile evidence if safely collectible without delaying urgent containment.
isolate_endpoint.verify: EDR isolation status plus independent network telemetry showing malicious communication stopped.
isolate_endpoint.rollback: Release isolation after incident-owner approval, eradication/rebuild, credential remediation, and health validation.

revoke_user_sessions.scope: Verified compromised user's affected sessions and refresh tokens. Avoid shared IP blocking.
revoke_user_sessions.preserve: Identity audit, session metadata, mailbox rules and access history.
revoke_user_sessions.verify: Identity provider confirms revocation; old sessions no longer work; malicious forwarding or grants are removed through separately approved remediation.
revoke_user_sessions.rollback: Revoked sessions are not restored. Reauthenticate the verified user after credential and MFA remediation.

disable_access_key.scope: Exact compromised access key ID after dependency assessment.
disable_access_key.preserve: Cloud audit and object-access logs; key metadata without secret values.
disable_access_key.verify: Provider confirms inactive state and subsequent attempted uses are denied; review newly created credentials or grants.
disable_access_key.rollback: Prefer a newly issued least-privilege replacement and validated service recovery. Do not reenable a known stolen key.

quarantine_workload.scope: Exact pod/workload UID with a scoped network policy; account for controller recreation.
quarantine_workload.preserve: Runtime process, image digest, manifest, logs and relevant filesystem evidence.
quarantine_workload.verify: Policy is effective for the target and any replacement workload; miner or C2 egress stops; neighboring services stay healthy.
quarantine_workload.rollback: Deploy a known-good workload after image/credential/root-cause remediation; remove quarantine only with approval.

restrict_malicious_egress.scope: Verified malicious destination/flow with critical authentication and management traffic preserved; incident commander approves.
restrict_malicious_egress.preserve: Flow records, relevant host evidence, policy before/after versions and timestamps.
restrict_malicious_egress.verify: Rule hit counters and independent flows confirm blocking; critical service health remains intact. Scoped egress blocking alone does not eradicate compromise.
restrict_malicious_egress.rollback: Time-bound reviewed rule with saved prior configuration; restore only after threat remediation and dependency verification.

none.scope: No state-changing containment. Collect missing evidence or escalate as required.
none.preserve: Existing alert and telemetry, explicit gaps, source reliability and unresolved contradictions.
none.verify: Analyst or new evidence resolves uncertainty; absence of telemetry cannot justify closure.
